name: Canned Crushed Pineapple in 100% Juice
whyItWorks: Thermal pasteurization in canning denatures the harsh proteolytic enzyme bromelain (which burns ulcerated tissue in raw pineapple). The crushed texture breaks down long fibrous strands into tiny soft bits.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose crushed pineapple in its own juice, not heavy syrup. Drain liquid before eating or baking.
watchOuts: Contains natural fruit sugars; enjoy in moderate 1/2 cup portions in remission.
